participant_2.name: Amina
participant_2.personality: Resilient and expressive, Amina has a passion for dance despite her past struggles. She often uses humor to cope with challenges.
participant_2.background: I like to dance. I was born in Somalia. I was forced to marry when I was a teenager. My aunt helped me escape when I was in my early twenties. Now I live in the United States.
